title: Metering
description: Metering and rating contracts from SPEC 16. The central rule (SPEC 16.1) is that units and prices are separate: emitters write units into usage_events and only the rating worker converts them to credits, stamping the price book version on every charge so a support question about a past invoice is answerable exactly.

Meter.title: Meter
Meter.description: SPEC 16.2. The four token meters stay separate deliberately - they differ by roughly an order of magnitude in cost. What each one receives is NOT the obvious mapping: tokens_in takes the agent's already cache-adjusted input (so billable input is tokens_in + tokens_cache_read + tokens_cache_write), and tokens_out takes output PLUS reasoning, because the agent's output field excludes reasoning and SPEC 16.2 mandates no fifth meter. Emitting the upstream fields verbatim under-bills by the whole cache volume and never bills reasoning at all. See docs/verified.md, SPEC 22 item 6.

Unit.title: Unit
Unit.description: What one unit of a meter's quantity measures.

MeterClass.title: MeterClass
MeterClass.description:
SPEC 16.3 gives build and runtime different exhaustion behaviours: build pauses the builder, which is harmless because the user is at the keyboard, while runtime follows a policy ladder because the spend is driven by someone else's end users. `passthrough` is billed at cost and shown as its own line so it does not look like margin (SPEC 16.2, domain_year).

Classification lives in price book data rather than in this enum because it is a commercial decision, not a type.

credits_per_unit.description: Decimal string, for the same exactness reason as Credits. More fractional digits than Credits because a per-token price is very small while a charge is not.

PriceBook.title: PriceBook
PriceBook.description: SPEC 6 price_books. Versioned and immutable once effective: every charge stamps the version it was rated under.

items.description: Keyed by meter. A meter with no entry is not billable under this version, which is different from being priced at zero.

UsageEvent.title: UsageEvent
UsageEvent.description: SPEC 6 usage_events. Carries units only — never credits. The unique (source, event_key) pair makes emission idempotent, which is what lets a crashed emitter retry without double-charging (SPEC 17.2).

event_key.description: Idempotency key chosen by the emitter, unique within its source.

quantity.description: numeric(20,6) in SPEC 6; a decimal string for the same reason as Credits.
